# CR-9203: Acme Manufacturing credit limit increase to $1,000,000

**Yes, it can be approved, but not by Sarah Chen alone.** Acme qualifies for $1,000,000 once the parent guarantee is counted. The limit needs Elena Novak (Director of Finance) to approve it, with Michael Torres (VP Sales) concurring. One thing blocks action first: **CR-9203 is not in the Northstar ERP credit-request records.**

## 1. The request
- **What was submitted:** CR-9203, customer C-1001, raising the limit from $250,000 to $1,000,000. Sarah Chen requested it on 2026-09-23, citing the Acme Group parent guarantee.
- **What the system of record shows:** `credit_requests.csv` has no CR-9203. The only pending Acme request is **CR-9201**, which raises the limit from $250,000 to $400,000. Its stated basis is the third-plant ramp-up, not the guarantee. Sarah's email to Priya Shah confirms CR-9201 was for $400,000 and mentions the guarantee only for "more headroom later."
- I decided CR-9203 as submitted, not CR-9201, and made confirming that CR-9203 exists a blocking condition.

## 2. The customer
Several records refer to the same company:
- ERP: C-1001, Acme Mfg. Holdings
- CRM: CRM-2048, Acme Manufacturing, **Strategic** tier
- The DUNS number (04-812-7730) and address match across both.

Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044 / CRM-2091) is a different company.

## 3. The policy
The Northstar Credit Policy 2026 applies (in effect 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31).

## 4. Payment history
The rule: no invoice due in the 12 months before the request may be paid more than 30 days late, or be unpaid more than 30 days past due.

| Invoice | Due date | Paid | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-60412 | 2025-11-28 | 2025-11-24 | On time |
| INV-62011 | 2026-07-25 | 2026-07-22 | On time |
| INV-62305 ($720,000) | 2026-10-02 | Unpaid | Not yet due on the request date, so not late |

The payment history passes.

## 5. Maximum limit
- The policy maximum for a Strategic account is $750,000.
- Parent guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 adds $400,000. It is in force from 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31 and names Acme Mfg. Holdings, so it covers this customer.
- The maximum is therefore **$1,150,000**, and the requested $1,000,000 is within it.

## 6. The requestor's authority
Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive. The credit policy gives that role no authority to approve credit limits.

## 7. Required approvers
For a $1,000,000 limit:
- **Approval:** a limit above $500,000 needs the Director of Finance, **Elena Novak**.
- **Concurrence:** a Strategic account above $500,000 also needs VP Sales concurrence, from **Michael Torres**.

Neither is the requestor, so the separation-of-duties rule doesn't apply.

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9203", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001; CRM-2048 Acme Manufacturing)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 1000000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen (sarah.chen@northstar.example)", "basis": "guarantee"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 1150000,
                  "basis": "Credit Policy 2026: Strategic maximum $750,000 + $400,000 parent guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 (Acme Group Holdings, Inc.) naming Acme Mfg. Holdings, in force 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31; no invoice due 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23 paid or unpaid more than 30 days past due",
                  "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance, with VP Sales concurrence (Strategic account, limit > $500,000)",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "Michael Torres", "role": "VP Sales", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["structured/credit_requests.csv (no CR-9203; CR-9201 pending for C-1001)", "structured/customers.csv (C-1001)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2048, Strategic)", "structured/erp_credit.csv (C-1001 limit $250,000)", "structured/erp_invoices.csv (INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305)", "documents/credit_policy_2026.md", "documents/acme_parent_guarantee.md (GRT-ACME-2026)", "structured/employees.csv", "documents/organization_chart.md", "documents/email_sarah_to_priya.md"],
  "missing_evidence": ["CR-9203 record in Northstar ERP credit requests"],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Confirm that request CR-9203 ($250,000 to $1,000,000 for C-1001, dated 2026-09-23) exists in Northstar ERP; the system of record contains only CR-9201 ($250,000 to $400,000) for this customer", "who": "Sarah Chen / Finance (Priya Shah)", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Reconcile CR-9203 with pending CR-9201 for the same customer (withdraw or supersede CR-9201) so that only one limit change is applied", "who": "Sarah Chen / Finance", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
